topic: Subagent lifecycle, context inheritance, recursion limits

claims.claim: Each subagent runs in its own isolated context window - the parent's conversation history does not carry over.
A subagent inherits 4 things: CLAUDE.md (project + user + nested), MCP servers, skills registered for its scope, tool allowlist (subject to frontmatter filter).
A subagent does NOT inherit 5 things: parent conversation history, parent's open files, parent's current tool state, parent's memory writes since session start, parent's transient variables.
Maximum recursion depth is 1: a subagent cannot spawn its own subagents via the Task/Agent tool. This is a hard architectural limit.
Subagents pay a large 'entry tax' on first turn: system prompt + CLAUDE.md chain + MCP tool descriptions + built-in schemas = commonly 20-50k tokens BEFORE useful work.
Subagent output is returned to the parent as a compressed summary, not raw transcript; the parent does not see the subagent's intermediate tool calls unless the subagent surfaces them.
Subagent sessions can be resumed, but user prompts are NOT preserved in the resumed transcript (Issue #11712) - resumed agents must infer original intent, often hallucinating corrections.
The Task/Agent tool is NOT automatically exposed to nested agents (Issue #4182) - even the general-purpose subagent cannot spawn further subagents.
Subagent transcripts are persisted at ~/.claude/projects/.../subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl for replay/debugging.
claims.source: Anthropic hooks docs (agent_transcript_path in SubagentStop payload)

claims.claim: SubagentStart fires when subagent is spawned (cannot block, can inject context). SubagentStop fires when subagent finishes (CAN block - force continuation).
GitHub Issue #10164 documents subagent context window sizing confusion: subagents use parent's model context limit unless overridden; easy to exhaust with large initial payloads.
Issue #25569 - subagent tool-use loop can stall on certain tool combinations; workaround is maxTurns cap.
Subagent lifetime: spawned -> initial prompt processed -> tool-use loop (bounded by maxTurns or completion) -> final result returned to parent -> context discarded.
Subagents cannot communicate with siblings directly - only the main agent receives results. For peer-to-peer communication, use Agent Teams (see R6).
CLAUDE.md inheritance is cumulative: project > user > plugin files are all concatenated into the subagent's system prompt (no override semantics, additive).

conflicts_flagged.description: Some community posts suggest nested subagent spawn is possible via agent teams, but that's Agent Teams (separate feature), not subagent recursion. True max_depth=1 for Task/Agent tool.
conflicts_flagged.resolution_hint: Clarify in synthesis: Task recursion limit = 1; Agent Teams is a separate orchestration layer.

gaps_flagged.description: No published token-overhead measurements from Anthropic - only community reports (20-50k entry tax).
Semantics of skills/MCP inheritance across isolation boundaries not fully explicit in docs.
Max recursion depth not explicitly written in official docs; inferred from Issue #4182 behavior.
